title: AOE Lightning Explosion
description: fx-aoe-lightning v1.0 explosion pack. Effect-only, no character. 30 frames @ 10 fps (100 ms), once, 3.0s. Cell 270×200. Sheet 1620×1000 is a 6×5 row-major grid. Origin (0.5, 0.75) is pixel anchor (135, 150), the ground center of the magic circle. Story: START glowing yellow concentric magic circle → BLAST lightning bolts and flash → FADE scorched ground and blue embers. Tag AOE, lightning, normal×1.2, multi-tick. The cell is already normal×1.2 versus the 225px dust baseline (270 = 225 × 1.2); play at scale 1. Visual duration is 3.0s. Multi-tick damage timing is Gameplay's call. Catalog only. Separate from the v0.26 residue puff vfx-aoe-lightning (96×96, origin centre).

assets.note: AOE lightning explosion v1.0. Effect-only (no character, no body ghost). 30 frames @ 10 fps, once (100 ms/frame, 3.0s). Cell 270×200. Sheet 1620×1000 is a 6×5 row-major grid: frame i is column i%6, row floor(i/6). Anchor (135, 150) = origin (0.5, 0.75), the ground center of the magic circle. START f0–f7 glowing yellow concentric magic circle and blue/yellow sparks. BLAST f8–f16 jagged yellow lightning bolts, white/yellow impact flash, and shockwave arcs (peak f16). FADE f17–f29 charred ground scorch, grey smoke, and lingering blue electric embers. Tag AOE, lightning, normal×1.2, multi-tick. Cell width is already normal×1.2 versus the 225px dust baseline; play at scale 1. Spawn so the anchor sits on the ground center. The visual is a 3.0s one-shot. Multi-tick damage is Gameplay's call; the sheet does not encode hit timing. Atlas: fx-aoe-lightning.json. Catalog only — Gameplay owns the Stage wire. Separate from vfx-aoe-lightning under fx/v026.
